assertions.assertion: Calls AddLocalApiAuthentication() to set up local API authentication
Mentions that clients must include 'IdentityServerApi' in their AllowedScopes
assertions.rationale: It only says the token must carry 'the appropriate API scope' and clients should request 'the scope your endpoints expect'; it never names the required IdentityServerApi scope.

assertions.assertion: Warns that local API authentication only works when the API is co-hosted with IdentityServer, not for separate API hosts
assertions.rationale: States the approach is specific to the co-hosted scenario and to switch to JWT bearer/introspection if the API is split into its own service.
